speakers.headline: Presidente Scriba.AI
speakers.biographyMd: Marco Landi is an international figure of the IT sector. During his thirty-years long career he has worked as President of Texas Instruments Europe and Asia, head of BMC Europe and Asia, but his is mostly known for his years spent in Cupertino as President and COO of Apple Computer in the years before Steve Jobs' comeback to the company. Marco Landi today is an investor and a mentor for start-up companies, he sits in several high-tech companies' Boards, and acts as honorary president and advisor of Scriba.AI, where he is also a lead investor.
